briefdescription.para: Unit tests for HTTP per-request timeout and graceful-shutdown patterns (P5-S02).

detaileddescription.para: All tests operate on configuration structs and in-file logic mirrors; no live server instance is required.

Coverage:
Default request_timeout_ms is 30 000 ms
Default graceful_shutdown_timeout_ms is 30 000 ms
request_timeout_ms is configurable
graceful_shutdown_timeout_ms is configurable
Zero request_timeout_ms disables the per-request timeout
Per-request timeout triggers 408 after deadline (logic mirror)
Fast request completes before timeout — no 408 fired
Timeout comparison uses steady_clock (not system_clock)
Drain loop exits when all requests complete before deadline

Drain loop force-closes when drain timeout expires
In-flight counter increments and decrements correctly
Graceful shutdown with zero in-flight requests completes immediately
Concurrent requests: all complete or timeout independently
Read-timeout configuration matches write-timeout configuration
Config copy preserves all timeout fields
Multiple sequential requests each get fresh timeout
